rationale.text: Each link is an a element with href whose content is text, directly or in a child span. The test asks whether each link has a name between and , the methodology checks that the content of the element contains a name (text or alternative), and the glossary builds the name of a text link from the text in it and in its child elements. Every link has one. The custom check answers no_fault (step 1), so the finding is needs_review, not_enabled, at fail_only; its link is resolving, so at full the derivation would give passed.

citations.quote: Dans chaque page web, chaque lien a-t-il un intitulé entre `` et ``
Pour chaque lien, vérifier que le contenu de l’élément `<a>` (ou d’un élément pourvu d’un attribut WAI-ARIA `role=link`) contient un intitulé (texte ou alternative)
du texte contenu dans les éléments enfants du lien.
